question_text: Choose the sentence with correct parallel structure:

options.text: She likes reading, to write, and painting.
She likes to read, write, and to paint.
She likes reading, writing, and painting.
She likes to read, writing, and paint.

hint_ladder.title: Spot the Pattern
hint_ladder.text: Kapag may listahan sa sentence, tingnan kung pare-pareho ang ending. Parang magkakapatid, dapat pare-pareho ng damit.

hint_ladder.title: Dalawang Porma Lang
hint_ladder.text: Ang listahan ay pwedeng lahat -ing (gerund) o lahat to + verb (infinitive). Bawal maghalo ng dalawang uniform.

hint_ladder.title: Check Bawat Option
hint_ladder.text: Option A: reading, to write, painting – may infinitive sa gitna. B: to read, write, to paint – may walang 'to'. D: to read, writing, paint – tatlo ...

hint_ladder.title: Ang Consistent Choice
hint_ladder.text: Option C lang ang pantay-pantay: reading, writing, painting. Lahat gerund, walang halo. Parang grocery list na lahat prutas, walang gulay.

A.text: You might have chosen A because umpisang gerund, ending gerund, pero gitnang 'to write' ay infinitive. Bawal maghalo, parang party na may...

B.text: You might have chosen B because may 'to read' at 'to paint', pero 'write' walang 'to'. Dapat kung infinitive ang isa, infinitive lahat – ...

C.text: Correct. Lahat gerunds (reading, writing, painting) — pare-parehong porma, parang terno. Walang halo, walang kulang.

D.text: You might have chosen D because puro verb forms, pero to read (infinitive), writing (gerund), paint (bare) – tatlong magkakaibang anyo. H...

next_time_rule: Rule: Sa listahan, pumili ng isang porma—lahat -ing o lahat to + verb. Huwag paghaluin, parang terno lang.
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo nagpaplano ka ng programa sa barangay: 'Gusto ko ng cooking, to dance, at singing.' Medyo magulo diba? Dahil hindi pare-pareho ang format. Iyan ang parallel structure — kapag listahan ng actions, dapat lahat iisang 'damit'.

Sa English, ang listahan pwedeng lahat -ing (gerund) o lahat to + verb (infinitive). Parang terno-terno lang. Bawal paghaluin, gaya ng A: reading (gerund), to write (infinitive), painting (gerund) — halo. B: to read, write (kulang ng to), to paint — inconsistent. D: ...

C lang ang tamang-tama: reading, writing, painting — lahat gerund, pantay-pantay. Walang sablay, parang magkakapatid na naka-uniporme.

Mental trick: Habang nagbabasa sa exam, mabilis mong i-label bawat item: 'ing ba o to?' Kung hindi magkakatulad, alisin mo agad. Parang pagpili ng prutas sa palengke — dapat pare-pareho ang hitsura bago ilista.
